decision_conditions: <p>The proposed lightwell, by reason of its size and detailed design, occupies more than half the front garden area, is not of a subordinate depth and width to respect the integrity of the host building, and does not incorporate any meaningful landscaping, thus failing to meet the good design principles required by policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach), and D4 (Delivering good design) of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP1 (<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Design Quality and Local Character)</span>&nbsp;and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and the requirements of Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).&nbsp;</p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-ed28eb46-7fff-1f67-5234-e49c45ccba0b"></span><br></p>

<p>The proposed basement residential unit will suffer from a lack of light, a poor outlook for the entire unit, and poor quality amenity space in a small lightwell covered by an overhead grille.&nbsp; Furthermore, the BRE report submitted does not use the expected methodology required, and the 30-degree line from the basement unit is not taken from the centre of the new basement windows, resulting in a sub-standard form of accommodation for future occupiers. In addition, the proposal results in a dumbing down of a previously agreed high-quality proposal through the loss of two landscaped amenity spaces on the ground floor main Nevill Road frontage to the detriment of the host building, the terrace which it forms part of, and the visual amenities of the surrounding area. The proposal is, therefore, contrary to policies D3 (<span id="docs-internal-guid-19db786c-7fff-2175-1f4c-17349254cc51"><span style="font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; background-color: transparent; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline; white-space-collapse: preserve;">Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach</span></span>), D4 (Delivering good design) and D6 (Housing standards) of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP1 (<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Design Quality and Local Character</span>) and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan (2020) and the Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025) and the Technical Housing Standards&nbsp;- nationally described space standard (2015).&nbsp;</p>
